title: Rethinking Retrieval in the Long-Context Era: Training-Free Semantic Trees for Adaptive Context Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.34146v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-context language models can increasingly process entire documents, making full-context prompting a practical alternative to passage retrieval. However, greater capacity determines how much information a model can receive, but not which information best supports a query. This distinction motivates rethinking retrieval: when the full document already fits, can selecting and organizing its evidence improve answering? The challenge is to retain supporting facts and relations while keeping the context focused on the question. To reconcile these goals, we introduce \ours, a training-free framework that uses semantic abstraction to guide selection while retaining original text for answering. \ours constructs a reusable semantic hierarchy from the full document in a single generation, linking node descriptions to source spans. Given a query, structural--semantic scoring and fine-grained lexical attribution nominate shared source nodes; th

translated_title: 长上下文时代的检索再思考：用于自适应上下文构建的无训练语义树
translated_abstract: 长上下文语言模型日益能够处理整篇文档，使得全上下文提示成为段落检索的一种实用替代方案。然而，更大的容量只决定了模型能接收多少信息，而不能决定哪些信息最能支持特定查询。这一区别促使我们重新思考检索：当整篇文档已经能够放入上下文时，选择和组织其中的证据能否改善问答效果？挑战在于如何保留支持性事实和关系，同时使上下文聚焦于问题。为了调和这些目标，我们提出了 \ours，一个免训练框架，它利用语义抽象来指导选择，同时保留原始文本用于回答。\ours 在单次生成中从完整文档构建一个可复用的语义层次结构，将节点描述链接到源文本片段。给定一个查询，结构-语义评分和细粒度词汇归因会提名共享的源节点……
tldr: 该论文提出了一种免训练的语义树框架，在长上下文模型时代通过语义抽象与结构-语义评分自适应地选择和组织证据，在保留原文的前提下构建聚焦于查询的上下文，从而提升问答效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free semantic tree framework that adaptively selects and organizes evidence in the long-context era via semantic abstraction and structural-semantic scoring, constructing query-focused contexts while retaining original text to improve question answering.
